label: Code Project setup gaps
means: Checks this repo fails: AGENTS.md, a CLAUDE.md that imports it, the never-push-to-main rule, a pull request template, an issue form, a CI workflow and valid .claude/settings.json.
goal_source: template goal: every file a cloud thread reads first, or writes into, exists; Claude Code Memory (read 2026-11-25) loads CLAUDE.md and its @ imports at the start of every session, and Claude Code Projects (read 2026-11-25) starts each thread on its own branch of the attached repo
source: files of this repo's checkout, read by collectors/projects/projects.mjs; a missing file is a gap, never not measured

params.comment: Paths under the repo root. agents_file: the shared rules file OpenCode and Claude Code both read. claude_file: must import agents_file on a line of its own. pr_template: the first file that exists. issue_forms: a folder holding at least one form besides config.yml. workflows: a folder holding at least one workflow. settings: the project's Claude Code settings.

label: One setup check
means: Seconds one run takes to read every file of the setup check.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the check reads a handful of local files, so it finishes within a second, near five
source: wall time of collectors/projects/projects.mjs, from the first file read to the last

label: Words in the pull request template
means: Words every thread reads when it opens a pull request, so each one costs tokens on every pull request.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a template is a layout to fill in, so it fits a screen at 150 words, near 300; Claude Code Costs (read 2026-11-25) says text loaded every session costs tokens every session
source: words of the first pull request template found by collectors/projects/projects.mjs; not measured when the repo has none
